label: Area & Specialty Rug Cleaning
safetyNote: Not every rug can be safely cleaned in-home. Natural fibers like wool, cotton, and jute can brown, bleed, or shrink if they're cleaned the wrong way, so I test the fibers and dyes before any work begins. If a rug needs care beyond what I can do safely, I'll tell you honestly and point you to someone who can handle it, no charge for the assessment.
